PaymentCredential.title: PaymentCredential
PaymentCredential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

StakeCredential.title: StakeCredential
StakeCredential.description:
Represent a type of object that can be represented either inline (by hash)
 or via a reference (i.e. a pointer to an on-chain location).

 This is mainly use for capturing pointers to a stake credential
 registration certificate in the case of so-called pointer addresses.

cardano/address/Address.title: Address
cardano/address/Address.description:
A Cardano `Address` typically holding one or two credential references.

 Note that legacy bootstrap addresses (a.k.a. 'Byron addresses') are
 completely excluded from Plutus contexts. Thus, from an on-chain
 perspective only exists addresses of type 00, 01, ..., 07 as detailed
 in [CIP-0019 :: Shelley Addresses](https://github.com/cardano-foundation/CIPs/tree/master/CIP-0019/#shelley-addresses).

cardano/address/Credential.title: Credential
cardano/address/Credential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/transaction/OutputReference.title: OutputReference
cardano/transaction/OutputReference.description:
An `OutputReference` is a unique reference to an output on-chain. The `output_index`
 corresponds to the position in the output list of the transaction (identified by its id)
 that produced that output

geniusyield/dex_v2/types/multisig/Multis.title: MultisigScript
geniusyield/dex_v2/types/multisig/Multis.description: Governs cancellation conditions for an order. Minting policy would ensure that when an order is created, this entries (`signatures` & `scripts`) are sorted.

fields.title: signatures
fields.description: List of signatures required to cancel the order.

fields.title: scripts
fields.description: List of stake validator scripts that must be satisfied to cancel the order.

geniusyield/dex_v2/types/order/AssetDeta.title: AssetDetails
geniusyield/dex_v2/types/order/AssetDeta.description: Details of an asset involved in an order.

fields.title: asset_class
fields.description: Asset class.

fields.title: amount
fields.description: Available amount of this asset.

geniusyield/dex_v2/types/order/FillRedee.title: FillRedeemer
geniusyield/dex_v2/types/order/FillRedee.description: Redeemer payload for stake fills. Supplies fresh oracle data keyed by order NFT names.

fields.title: owner
fields.description: Owner of the order who has the right to cancel it.

fields.title: payment_addr
fields.description: Address to receive payment when position is closed. When an order closes, every asset held in the output (except the identifying NFT) is returned to this address.

fields.title: nft_name
fields.description: Name of the NFT that is used to identify this order.

fields.title: a
fields.description: Details of asset `a`.

fields.title: b
fields.description: Details of asset `b`.

fields.title: price
fields.description: See [`Price`](#Price).

fields.title: validity_start
fields.description: Posix timestamp after this order is valid for filling.

fields.title: validity_end
fields.description: Posix timestamp after this order is no longer valid for filling.

fields.title: taker_lovelace_flat_fee
fields.description: Flat taker fee in lovelace required to be paid when filling this order. Note that if we are filling multiple orders in a single transaction, we take maximum `taker_lovelace_flat_fee` from all orders.

fields.title: taker_fee_ratio
fields.description:
Fee ratio that taker has to pay when filling this order.
 Represented as a rational fraction; e.g. 0.3% = Rational { numerator: 3, denominator: 1000 }.

fields.title: maker_fee_ratio
fields.description:
Fee ratio that gets deducted from maker's allocated fee when filling this order.
 Represented as a rational fraction; e.g. 0.3% = Rational { numerator: 3, denominator: 1000 }.

fields.title: oracle_freshness_seconds
fields.description: Maximum oracle price age (seconds) accepted when filling this order.

geniusyield/dex_v2/types/order/OrderRede.title: OrderRedeemer
geniusyield/dex_v2/types/order/OrderRede.description: Available order actions. Note that per transaction, only one common action is allowed across all involved orders. I.e., if two orders are being consumed in same transaction, redeemer for both should be same. This is required so that we don't confuse order cancellation with order fill, as it is difficult to distinguish between the two when folding over multiple orders in our stake validator.

anyOf.title: CancelOrder
anyOf.description: "Owner" of the author triggers "order cancellation". Note that owner can cancel multiple orders in a single transaction. If one wants to update their position, they can cancel the order and create a new one in the same transaction.

fields.title: output_ref
fields.description: Reference to the output that is being consumed.

fields.title: amount
fields.description: Amount of tokens being created.

geniusyield/dex_v2/types/order/Price.title: Price
geniusyield/dex_v2/types/order/Price.description: Price that is set in the order. Note that if you would not like order to be closed when completely filled, set `reverse` to some non-`None` value such that it is detrimental to fill it in reverse direction.

anyOf.title: DeltaOracle
anyOf.description: Price given as a delta to oracle price.

geniusyield/dex_v2/types/order/PriceDelt.title: PriceDelta
geniusyield/dex_v2/types/order/PriceDelt.description: Price delta to be applied to oracle price input to get for final price. Actual price is `o * (1 + spread) + offset` where `o` is the oracle price.

fields.title: base_asset
fields.description: Base asset (asset A in the price pair).

fields.title: quote_asset
fields.description: Quote asset (asset B in the price pair).

fields.title: price
fields.description: The price.

fields.title: timestamp
fields.description: Timestamp when this price was signed/measured (POSIX milliseconds).

geniusyield/dex_v2/types/rational/Ration.title: Rational
geniusyield/dex_v2/types/rational/Ration.description: Rational number. Note that there are no checks performed to ensure that denominator is non-zero & positive. Order creation logic is expected to ensure this. Such invariants is the reason that validator should only consider those orders which have the required NFT.
